before-completing-prince-ali-rescue-ques.player: Can I come through this gate?

before-completing-prince-ali-rescue-ques.speaker: Guard
before-completing-prince-ali-rescue-ques.text: You must pay a toll of 10 gold coins to pass.

options.text: No thank you, I'll walk around.

steps.player: No, thank you. I'll walk around.

options.text: Who does my money go to?

steps.player: Who does my money go to?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.text: The money goes to the city of Al-Kharid.
(The player goes through the gate and 10gp are subtracted from their inventory)
If the player does not have 10gp:

steps.player: Oh dear, I don't actually seem to have enough money.

after-completing-prince-ali-rescue-quest.player: Can I come through this gate?

after-completing-prince-ali-rescue-quest.speaker: Guard
after-completing-prince-ali-rescue-quest.text: You may pass for free, you are a friend of Al-Kharid.
(The player goes through the gate, but no money is subtracted from their inventory)

during-death-to-the-dorgeshuun-with-prin.player: Can we come through this gate?

during-death-to-the-dorgeshuun-with-prin.speaker: Guard
during-death-to-the-dorgeshuun-with-prin.text: You may pass for free, for you are a friend of Al-Kharid, but your goblin friend must stay on this side.

during-death-to-the-dorgeshuun-with-prin.speaker: Guard
during-death-to-the-dorgeshuun-with-prin.text: Why do you think this gate is here, if not to keep the goblins out of Al Kharid?

during-death-to-the-dorgeshuun-with-prin.player: But Zanik isn't like the other goblins!

during-death-to-the-dorgeshuun-with-prin.speaker: Zanik
during-death-to-the-dorgeshuun-with-prin.text: Nevermind, player name. I don't think we need to go to Al Kharid anyway!

during-leagues-without-having-the-requir.player: Can I come through this gate?

during-leagues-without-having-the-requir.npc: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to both the Misthalin and Kharidian Desert areas in this League.

during-leagues-without-having-the-requir.text: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to both the Misthalin and Kharidian Desert areas in this League.
